generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document .

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The prospective Bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor at least one similar work of Supply and installation of License Free Walkie-Talkie sets with Signal booster not less thanRs. 2.5 lakhs in any reputed Industry/Private sector/PSU/Government organization in the preceding five years (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25&2025-26). In proof of this, the bidder should submit work order and relevant work done certificate duly certified by competent authority. (A weight age of 10% per year is applicable to previous work orders to bring the current price level of 2025-26)

The intending bidder should have minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 5.0 Lakhs in any two years during the preceding 5 financial years. Financial turnover of previous year will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of Present financial year.(i.e. For the period(2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25&2025-26). As a proof, the bidder shall upload scanned copies of turnover certificate or profit & loss statement duly certified by Chartered Accountant

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Turn over certificate /Profit loss statement duly certified by Charted Accountant
